tips_en: Read TurnWise first: it offers a crisp diagnosis of trajectory-level RL’s credit-assignment problem and a well-ablated turn-level alternative, with strong gains and reduced repetition. Pair it with the multi-turn RL study, which similarly finds that trajectory-level gains do not imply uniformly better local decisions and highlights robustness under tight budgets; NEO-VLA offers a looser parallel by preserving action-critical intermediate information rather than relying on a fixed endpoint.
tips_zh: 建议先读 TurnWise：它清晰指出了轨迹级强化学习的信用分配问题，并提出消融充分的逐轮次替代方案，同时显著减少重复。可将其与多轮强化学习论文对照阅读，后者同样发现轨迹层面的提升并不等于每一步决策都变好，并强调预算受限时的稳健性；NEO-VLA 则呈现一种较松散的类比，即保留动作所需的中层信息，而不是依赖固定的末端表征。
